scope: One visual pass, followed by one performance/stability pass with the complete check:all suite.

visualPass.palette: Warmer orange loam, brighter blue sky and cool fill, saturated teal/gold festival cloth and structures. Wet reflections, fire, sun corona/lens ghosts and soft camera mud remain.

cartoonStyleNudge.status: verified visually at native 1600x900 and normal 720p

mudTracks.details: Two real tyre histories per occupied grounded cart; no marks in air, at rest, during a rollover or across respawns. Course-local bounded pools retain trails for up to 110 seconds.

moreDirtBuildup.details: Faster accumulated mud; broader, lighter loam patches collect on lower panels and wheels, preserving green charge rings. Sixty-second driving fixture reaches full mud coverage.

thirtyPercentLessDurability.details: Collision capacity 16 -> 11.2; direct weapon health loss 0.5 * power -> (0.5 / 0.7) * power. Both scale to 70% of previous durability.

bigStadiumLights.details: 34 six-lamp towers, recessed silver reflectors, brass rims/visors, warm lenses, teal bracing and access ladders. No added real-time light or shadow passes.

performanceAndStabilityPass.details: Changed-range tyre uploads, hidden expired histories, shared floodlight vertices, single wetness sample per cart, no unchanged wear uploads. Five restarts retain 524 GPU geometries and 83 textures; all 24 history buffers disposed each time.

fullSuiteOnSecondPass.details: 201 commands: 161 passed, 40 failed. All 39 previous failures recur. One additional skate replay failure passes unchanged on isolated rerun.

desktopLoading.details: All 13 Chrome production startup/recovery scenarios pass; actual in-app browser title screen, rally grid, countdown and driving run with no warnings/errors.

preserveHandlingMoundsAndEffects.details: All twelve full-height doubles passed with zero rolls/respawns; 2240 support samples pass. All eight racers finish full-render combat with zero falls; every rival fires. Controls, existing route and mound profiles unchanged.

delivery: Commit and Pages verification recorded in deployment.json after publication.
